text: Three small weights A , B and C , each attached to a spring, are oscillating vertically above level ground. The height, h cm, above the ground of each weight at time t seconds, t ≥ 0 , is given by h A = 16 cos ( 3 π t 4 ) + 20 , h B = 12 sin ( 3 π t 4 ) + 25 , h C = 12 cos ( 5 π t 4 ) + 20 . (a) State which two weights are oscillating with the same amplitude, and state what this common amplitude is. (2 marks) (b) State which two weights are oscillating with the same period, and state what this common period is. (2 marks) (c) State which of the weights reaches furthest above the ground and state the time at which it first reaches this position. (3 marks) (d) Determine the length of time during the first 3 seconds for which h C > h A > h B . (3 marks)
